questions.question: It was not until she had finished her PhD that she began to pursue a career in academia.
options: Her academic career only started after she had completed her PhD.
She decided to become an academic once she had finished her research degree.
Only when she had obtained her doctorate did she start working as an academic.
It was not until after completing her postgraduate studies that she began teaching.

questions.question: I wish I could afford to buy a house, but unfortunately, my salary is too low.
options: Although I wish I had more money, it's impossible for me to purchase a property.
If only I earned enough to buy a house, but that's not the case.
Unfortunately, my income doesn't allow me to afford a home, which is what I really want.
It would be wonderful if I could afford a house, but my current salary makes it unfeasible.

questions.question: By the time she arrived at the party, most of the guests had already left.
options: When she got to the party, nearly all the other people were still there.
It was only when she finally turned up that everyone else had departed.
The majority of the guests had gone home before she even arrived at the celebration.
She didn't have a chance to meet many people because most of them left early.

questions.question: I'm not sure whether I should accept the job offer or wait for something better.
options: Although I've been offered a position, I'm still uncertain about what to do.
It's difficult for me to decide between this opportunity and holding out for another one.
Whether or not I take the job is dependent on various factors that need consideration.
I am in two minds about whether to accept the offer or look for something more suitable.

questions.question: The fact that she was unable to find a job after graduating from university weighed heavily on her parents.
options: Her failure to secure employment following graduation caused significant distress.
It was the responsibility of her parents to deal with the consequences of her unemployment.
Not being able to get a job right away put a lot of pressure on her family.
The burden of her unemployment fell squarely on her shoulders.
